scientific_integrity: The source-date field uses the oldest precisely dated public repository posting inspected for the motivating paper (2009-10-21); its journal publication is known to be 1999 but its first public day has not been independently verified. The theorem is mathematically separate from those sources. Numerical checks support finite cases, not the proof of the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: Finite ordered uncentered interval averages only; two fixed positive endpoint masses and equal positive interior masses tending to zero. No exact fixed-epsilon formula or arbitrary-weight classification. An equivalent historical calculation may exist; no independent validation is claimed.
title: Endpoint-mass concentration and sharp Lipschitz amplification of discrete interval maximal averages
